description: Source code for the WebKitPatch class, a command-line tool managing multiple sub-commands related to WebKit development tasks, including command parsing, execution, and command registration.

classes.name: WebKitPatch
classes.description: A command-line tool class that manages multiple sub-commands for WebKit development tasks, handling command registration, argument parsing, and execution flow.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the WebKitPatch object with a given path, sets up command list and help command.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point to parse arguments, select and execute the appropriate command.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Returns the path associated with this WebKitPatch instance.

methods.name: _split_command_name_from_args
methods.description: Static method to extract command name and remaining arguments from argument list.

methods.name: _create_option_parser
methods.description: Creates and returns an option parser configured with usage and help.

methods.name: _add_global_options
methods.description: Adds global options to the provided option parser.

methods.name: _should_execute_command
methods.description: Determines if a command should be executed based on repository state.

methods.name: should_show_in_main_help
methods.description: Determines if a command should be shown in the main help listing.

methods.name: command_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves a command object by its name.
